slides.lead: England's regulator looked at more than 3.5 million samples from 2025.
Every year the DWI's Chief Inspector reports how England's public water supplies did against the legal standards.

paras: 99.97% of regulatory samples from public water supplies in England met the standards in 2025.
That's across more than 3.5 million samples.

slides.lead: Share of tests that met the standards, by group.
Almost half of the failures were linked to consumers' own distribution systems.

paras: 586 water quality events were reported in 2025: none major, 7 serious.
The DWI served 109 enforcement notices on water companies.

tips: Cloudy, but clears from the bottom up? It's tiny air bubbles.
Air clouding should normally clear within 24 hours.
Odd taste or smell, or cloudy for 24h+? Contact your supplier.
